title: Machine Learning-driven Fragment-based Discovery of CIB1-directed Anti-Tumor Agents by FRASE-bot.
authors: An, Yi; Glavatskikh, Marta; Lim, Jiwoong; Wang, Xiaowen; Norris-Drouin, Jacqueline; Hardy, P Brian; Leisner, Tina M; Pearce, Kenneth H; Kireev, Dmitri
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习从蛋白-配体复合物中提取片段信息，针对CIB1蛋白发现小分子配体，虽涉及转录因子类靶点但核心是蛋白-小分子药物发现，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Chemical probes are an indispensable tool for translating biological discoveries into new therapies, though are increasingly difficult to identify. Novel therapeutic targets are often hard-to-drug proteins, such as messengers or transcription factors. Computational strategies arise as a promising solution to expedite drug discovery for unconventional therapeutic targets. FRASE-bot exploits big data and machine learning (ML) to distill 3D information relevant to the target protein from thousands of protein-ligand complexes to seed it with ligand fragments. The seeded fragments can then inform either (i) de novo design of 3D ligand structures or (ii) ultra-large-scale virtual screening of commercially available compounds. Here, FRASE-bot was applied to identify ligands for Calcium and Integrin Binding protein 1 (CIB1), a promising but ligand-orphan drug target implicated in triple negative breast cancer. The signaling function of CIB1 relies on protein-protein interactions and its structure does not feature any natural ligand-binding pocket. FRASE-based virtual screening identified the first small-molecule CIB1 ligand (with binding confirmed in a TR-FRET assay) showing specific cell-killing activity in CIB1-dependent cancer cells, but not in CIB1-depleted cells.
abstract_zh: 化学探针是将生物学发现转化为新疗法不可或缺的工具，尽管其识别日益困难。新型治疗靶点往往是难以成药的蛋白质，如信使分子或转录因子。计算方法应运而生，成为加速非传统治疗靶点药物发现的可行解决方案。FRASE-bot利用大数据和机器学习（ML），从数千个蛋白质-配体复合物中提取与靶蛋白相关的三维信息，并以配体片段作为种子。这些种子片段随后可用于指导（i）三维配体结构的从头设计，或（ii）对市售化合物进行超大规模虚拟筛选。在此，FRASE-bot被应用于识别钙和整合素结合蛋白1（CIB1）的配体，CIB1是一个有前景但缺乏配体的药物靶点，与三阴性乳腺癌相关。CIB1的信号功能依赖于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，其结构不具备任何天然配体结合口袋。基于FRASE的虚拟筛选识别出首个CIB1小分子配体（其结合通过TR-FRET实验确认），该配体在CIB1依赖性癌细胞中表现出特异性细胞杀伤活性，而在CIB1缺失细胞中无此活性。
